title: Relative Entropy and the Inviscid Limit for Planar Shocks of the Multi-D Burgers' Equation
summary: In recent work (arXiv:2610.10341), the authors introduced a framework for studying the vanishing viscosity limit for sequences of weak solutions of the multi-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes equations to planar shocks of the compressible Euler equations. In this paper, we introduce these methods and apply them to the multi-dimensional viscous Burgers' equation. We show that arbitrarily large viscous shocks enjoy $L^2$-stability among perturbations whose gradients in the directions transverse to the shock are controlled in an appropriate manner.
